sections.content: Beyond basics, auditing means systematically checking: keyboard-only navigation, screen-reader output (headings order, landmarks, labels), color contrast, zoom to 200%, and reduced-motion preferences.
Tools help: axe DevTools and Lighthouse flag issues automatically, but manual keyboard and screen-reader passes catch what automation misses.
Key points: WCAG levels A/AA/AAA define conformance, focus order should match visual order, and error messages must say how to fix the problem.
